hiremeintro: Experienced, purpose driven, frontend focused, Sr. Software Engineer
hiremeText: I’ve developed a passion for crafting the forms, dials, and switches and reusable components that help other people work or manage their work environments. I create UX solutions that make sense and put what people need where they need it in a way that's intuitive and stylish.

I am full-stack capable and adept at quickly learning new languages and frameworks. My experience spans from PHP to C# to Node, and from HTML and jQuery to modern libraries like React. I have worked with various databases, version control systems, and hosting environments, collaborating effectively within diverse teams. I am well-versed in agile methodologies and have comprehensive experience with the entire software development life cycle—ranging from requirements gathering and architecture design to deployment and ongoing maintenance.

While not a designer, I do work well with designers, not simply replicating static designs but transforming them into dynamic, responsive pieces of code that adapt seamlessly to different screens sizes and data shapes.

“Dragon is a fantastic front-end developer who is an asset to every team she joins. She brings both deep technical knowledge and a willingness to jump in and help with anything. In fact, that customer focus/product mindset is one of her biggest strengths. She was often requested by name by our professional services customers because of her attention to detail and focus on helping the customer achieve their vision.” - Aaron Witt, Enterprise Cloud Architect | Engineering Leader | DevOps Devotee
